en: Black‑and‑white image of a mid‑20th‑century cargo or tanker ship underway at sea. The vessel is photographed in profile from the side, flying a line of decorative signal flags from bow to stern, suggesting a ceremonial or maiden voyage. The superstructure is concentrated toward the stern and midships, with cranes or loading arms visible on deck. The ship's name is painted on the bow, and large initials appear on the funnel.
